root_cause: Chief Engineer structural recovery treated a provider's local enum alias as grounds to discard a complete portfolio. It canonicalized artifact semantic roles but did not canonicalize the common verification modality alias qa->test, so the pipeline spent two full LLM calls reconstructing the whole portfolio and introduced new root-shape drift instead of preserving and validating the original candidate.

fix.behavior: At the Chief Engineer blueprint public normalization boundary, canonicalize only the exact verification modality alias qa to test, record normalize_qa_verification_modality, and leave every other unknown modality untouched so strict schema validation remains fail-closed.

verification.red: The exact complete-candidate fixture recovered the artifact role but retained verification.modality=qa and therefore still failed the CE output schema.
